name: Gizelton Caravan
summary: At Mannoroc Coven, Rigger Gizelton asks you to guard his caravan. He and Cork set out to make a fortune, but trade has proved more dangerous than they expected.

sections.title: Past Mannoroc Coven
sections.body: Rigger Gizelton and Cork began their caravan hoping to make a fortune. They did not know how risky turning a profit could be. Mannoroc Coven lies ahead, where demons usually leave the caravan alone. This time, the kodos are spooked. Rigger offers payment if you guard the caravan past the coven. Once it is safely through, Smeed will pay you at Scrabblescrew's Camp.

sections.title: Smeed's Misgivings
sections.body: At Scrabblescrew's Camp, Smeed wipes his brow and says the caravan's disappearance would ruin him. He is glad to hear it is not lost. Yet he questions paying so much to protect a caravan whose owners earn only one gold piece a week. Still, Cork and Rigger keep paying him for his kodos. He does not care how they run their business.

faq.answer: Rigger Gizelton owns a caravan he started with Cork, hoping they would make a fortune.

faq.q: Why does the caravan need protection past Mannoroc Coven?
faq.answer: Rigger says the demons at Mannoroc Coven usually leave the caravan alone, but something has the kodos spooked this time.

faq.q: Who pays you for protecting the caravan?
aliases: where to turn in gizelton caravan
faq.answer: Smeed, the Gizeltons' business associate at Scrabblescrew's Camp, pays you once the caravan is safely past the coven.
Cork is Rigger Gizelton's partner in the caravan.
